name: @mooring/x402-client
description: Pay x402-protected APIs from a Mooring spending card on Stellar.
//exports: ./errors is the card error table on its own, so a consumer that only translates contract errors (the web app) does not pull the payment client, its scheme and the @x402/* packages into its bundle.
//: @stellar/stellar-sdk is pinned exactly: CardExactStellarScheme records legacy (v1) auth credentials via `useUpgradedAuth: false`, a transitional flag the deployed OZ Channels facilitator still requires (see docs/x402-integration.md, CAP-71 note). An SDK that changes how auth credentials are recorded would silently change the payload; the client also asserts the recorded format at build time.
